answers.assumption_check: Assumed and unmeasured: that a ticket's PROVED can be read cheaply from its state record or journal by the lane (the build reads transitions.py and ticket_file.py first and records which); that plans needing a wait adopt outcome `after` or a BUILDME stage_needs entry (86cccb7d30f7 is a decisions plan and must be recast). The lane is a hypothesis the proof measures, not a settled design.
answers.builder_check: A Haiku builder needs and has: inspect_entry at cairn/tools/base/transitions.py:1045 with its _sieve_lane pattern; the cast-time shape check at cairn/tools/base/plan_shape.py (after = outcome numbers or 12-hex ticket ids); needs.py project_needs and its mark shape; the proof location cairn/tools/base/proofs/. It lacks how a ticket's PROVED is read and whether a ticket id may be absent from the store (a dependency on an unknown id is itself held); the ticket states both as the build's to measure and record.
answers.children: none, because the work is one entry lane and its proof: cairn/tools/base/transitions.py
answers.collision_check: No real collision. It adds a seventh lane to inspect_entry beside the six; stage-needs 43905593680a is the ledger this reads, and its child b (`cairn whatsnext`) is the report side, not a gate. The questions lane stays for choices only Akien's head settles.
answers.falsifier_check: Falsifier: a scratch ticket with an unproved `after` ticket id or an unmarked BUILDME need is refused at the BUILDME entry naming each; the same ticket with the ticket PROVED and the need marked DONE crosses. Horizon: the next ticket that must wait on another crosses only when it is proved.
answers.gates_bound: proved (Law 8: a proof a hollow build could not pass) and feeds back to origin on failure (Law 3): PROVEME runs the proof under the tester's seal on Linux; a red returns the ticket to FIXME.
answers.missing_check: Not wrapped: how a measured precondition that is not a ticket (akiendell pinned to the Dell) is re-measured, since a DONE mark is an observation with a when and may go stale; needs.py reports age and does not expire, and whether a mark ever expires is an open edge of ticket 43905593680a that this ticket does not decide. A stale DONE is read as DONE here, and its age is named in the finding.
answers.questions: none, because whether a ticket's PROVED is readable from state or journal is a CC-answerable hypothesis the proof measures, and the ledger it reads is ruled in ticket 43905593680a at CairnCommons/tickets/43905593680a-stage-needs.json
answers.title: a ticket's BUILDME crossing is held until every ticket it declares a dependency on is PROVED and every measured BUILDME need carries a DONE mark
